raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17 05:00) re-delivered about 345 rows already loaded at 02:00, with duplicate txn_ids (e.g. 903920) whose txn_ts is epoch milliseconds, '1768543211000', which equals the original 2026-01-16 06:00:11. The cast fails on that value, and the duplicates would also double-count spend. Deduplicating on txn_id (keeping the earliest ingest) and parsing epoch-ms timestamps in silver_transactions fixes both problems, and the gold tables stay unchanged.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH d AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM d WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
